concerns.text: The Data Model (data-model.md) defines a processed file `data/processed/filtered_samples.parquet` that records the samples retained after the ≥ 2‑visit filter. The Implementation Plan’s Phase 1 description (filtering & transformation) mentions retaining PD patients with ≥ 2 visits and writing `clr_abundances.parquet`, but it never creates or logs the `filtered_samples.parquet` artifact. This creates a mismatch between the plan and the data model, potentially breaking downstream tasks that expect the filtered sample file.
